items.exampleEn: Years later, she spoke remorsefully about the friends she had lost touch with.
items.exampleZh: 多年後，她懊悔地談起那些失去聯絡的朋友。

items.exampleEn: He was self-conscious about his new glasses at first.
items.exampleZh: 剛開始他很在意自己的新眼鏡，覺得難為情。
items.glossZh: 難為情的；在意別人眼光的

items.exampleEn: Losing the job hurt his sense of self-worth.
items.exampleZh: 失去那份工作，打擊了他的自我價值感。

items.exampleEn: We spent the last day of the trip stressfully searching for our passports.
items.exampleZh: 旅程最後一天，我們壓力重重地到處找護照。

items.exampleEn: The new manager was placed in an unenviably tough position.
items.exampleZh: 新經理被放在一個艱難到令人同情的位置上。
items.glossZh: 不令人羨慕地；令人同情地

items.exampleEn: She has remained unwaveringly loyal to her old friends.
items.exampleZh: 她對老朋友始終忠誠，從未動搖。
items.glossZh: 堅定不移地；始終如一地

items.exampleEn: The usually lively boy seemed withdrawn all week.
items.exampleZh: 那個平常很活潑的男孩，這整個星期都顯得很退縮、不說話。
items.glossZh: 孤僻退縮的；不愛說話的

items.sentenceEn: The fans supported their team unwaveringly through ten losing seasons.
items.sentenceZh: 球迷們在十個輸球的球季中始終堅定地支持球隊。

items.audioEn: He looked at the broken vase and apologized remorsefully to his grandmother.
items.audioZh: 他看著破掉的花瓶，懊悔地向奶奶道歉。
options: He bought her a new vase.
He blamed the cat for it.

items.sentenceEn: I feel self-conscious when I sing in front of other people.
items.sentenceZh: 在別人面前唱歌時，我會覺得很難為情。

items.sentenceEn: The coach worked hard to build up the players' self-worth.
items.sentenceZh: 教練很努力地幫球員建立自我價值感。

items.stemEn: She ____ believed in her son, even when others doubted him.
items.stemZh: 即使別人懷疑她兒子，她仍堅定不移地相信他。

items.stemEn: Shy and ____, the new employee ate lunch alone at her desk every day.
items.stemZh: 那位新員工害羞又孤僻退縮，每天都一個人在座位上吃午餐。

items.passageEn: When Ella moved to a new school at fourteen, she became withdrawn and rarely spoke in class. She was self-conscious about her accent and felt insecure, worried that others would laugh. Her music teacher, Mr. Kato, noticed and invited her to join the choir. At first she sang so quietly that no one could hear her, but Mr. Kato supported her unwaveringly, telling her that her voice mattered. Slowly, her sense of self-worth grew. Before the spring concert, she was given the unenviably difficult job of singing the first solo, and the weeks of practice passed stressfully. On the night, a classmate who had once teased her came up after the show and apologized remorsefully.
items.passageZh: Ella 十四歲轉到新學校時，變得很退縮，上課很少說話。她很在意自己的口音，也缺乏安全感，擔心別人會笑她。她的音樂老師 Kato 老師注意到了，邀她加入合唱團。一開始她唱得很小聲，沒人聽得到，但 Kato 老師始終堅定地支持她，告訴她她的聲音很重要。慢慢地，她的自我價值感增加了。春季演唱會前，她被分配到第一段獨唱，這份差事難度高，一點也不令人羨慕，練習的那幾週過得壓力重重。演出當晚，一位曾經取笑過她的同學在表演後走過來，懊悔地向她道歉。

questions.questionZh: Ella 剛轉學時為什麼很少說話？
options: 她跟新同學的興趣完全不同

questions.questionZh: 演唱會當晚發生了什麼事？
options: Kato 老師請她再多唱一首歌
她緊張到忘詞，只好重唱一次
一位曾取笑她的同學來道歉

items.promptZh: 她懊悔地承認是她弄壞了同事的筆電。
referenceEn: She remorsefully admitted that she had broken her colleague's laptop.
She admitted remorsefully that she was the one who broke her colleague's laptop.
rubricZh: 「懊悔地」用副詞 remorsefully，位置例如 admitted 前、admitted 後、句尾 等
「承認」用 admit，可接 that 子句（例如 admitted that she had broken…）
說的是已發生的事，時態配合內容（例如 admitted、had broken、broke）

items.promptZh: 第一次用英文開會時，他很怕說錯，覺得很難為情。
referenceEn: At his first meeting in English, he was self-conscious and afraid of making mistakes.
He felt self-conscious at his first English meeting because he was afraid of saying something wrong.
rubricZh: 「難為情」用 self-conscious（例如 was self-conscious、felt self-conscious 等）
「怕說錯」可寫，例如 afraid of making mistakes、afraid of saying something wrong 等
說的是已發生的事，時態配合內容；過去式、現在完成式都正確
